verdict.rationale: Proa serves its complete documentation at /llms-full.txt for agent consumption, and evidence items fetched from that URL show the file is live. It also documents per-route Markdown docs (e.g. /docs/agents.md) and scaffolds an AGENTS.md that describes project shape, render rules, validation commands and safe edit boundaries. missing for 10: a standard /llms.txt index (probe returned 404), a working Markdown version of the docs root (/docs.md returned 404, at odds with the 'every docs route' claim), and independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: The complete documentation is served at /llms-full.txt for agent consumption.
Every docs route exposes Markdown: curl https://proa.so/docs/agents.md
Keep AGENTS.md at the project root. It describes the local project shape, render rules, validation commands, and safe edit boundaries.
